description: Hot-adds a card on the private network and sets its address in the system, without a restart. configuration: manual means the address must be set by hand in the guest. Connecting again returns the same address. Scope: network.write.

ip.description: Address wanted in the range; default the next free one.

vm.description: Machine id, as returned by list_vms or create_vm.

vpc.description: Private network id, as returned by list_vpcs or create_vpc.

name: connect_vpc
title: Connect a machine to a private network
